name: summarize
summary: Build a deterministic extractive operational summary from source fragments and structured facts.
description: Third node of the report.* chain. Splits source_fragments into sentences, scores each by keyword overlap with structured_facts tokens, keeps the top 3 in original order, and renders a fixed template including the project name (defaulting to 'The project') and validated insight count. Pure, deterministic, memory-only.

use_cases.scenario: As a rollout coordinator, I want browser and edge evidence folded into a named project summary, so that stakeholders see one deterministic operational narrative.

source_fragments: Browser adoption rose. Edge cache is warm.
structured_facts: Fact: edge — Edge cache is warm

output_example.summary: Acme Rollout combines distributed browser, edge, and cloud evidence into a deterministic operational summary with 2 validated insights. Browser adoption rose. Edge cache is warm.

use_cases.scenario: As a rollout coordinator, I want a single validated insight to use singular wording when no project name is supplied, so that the default template still reads correctly.

output_example.summary: The project combines distributed browser, edge, and cloud evidence into a deterministic operational summary with 1 validated insight. Cloud latency improved.

use_cases.scenario: As a rollout coordinator, I want zero structured facts to still yield a header-only summary, so that an empty enrichment stage does not invent sentences.

output_example.summary: The project combines distributed browser, edge, and cloud evidence into a deterministic operational summary with 0 validated insights. Unrelated chatter here.

preconditions.description: Caller supplies source_fragments and structured_facts arrays (either may be empty).

postconditions.description: Identical input always yields an identical summary string. Sentence scoring and top-k selection use no randomness, clocks, or host state.

side_effects.description: Produces one summary string in memory; does not log, persist, or transmit inputs.

provenance.author: enricopiovesan
provenance.spec_ref: registry#426 / UMA chapter-13 report chain port

authoring.test_evidence: capability-src/report-summarize: 10 #[test] cases covering top-k, zero facts, missing/empty project_name, tie-break determinism; cargo llvm-cov functions=100%, lines/regions>=95%.
